name: glitchless
description: Coding agents can build a game. They can't see anyone play it. Glitchless lets them. Game observability for Three.js, Phaser, Babylon.js, PlayCanvas, Unity, Godot, Unreal and GameMaker: ranked findings, frame times, errors, where players die, store reviews and each game's own dashboard, from real players' sessions. Skills add Glitchless to a game, design its dashboard and fix what players hit.
